protocol.description: Create a HASH or JSON search index with TEXT, TAG, NUMERIC, GEO, or typed FLAT/HNSW VECTOR fields.

alias.description: Query-facing field alias, strongly recommended for JSON indexes.

field_type.description: TEXT, TAG, NUMERIC, GEO, or VECTOR.

name.description: Hash field name or JSONPath expression.

noindex.description: Store the field without indexing it.

nostem.description: Disable stemming for a TEXT field.

sortable.description: Make the field available to SORTBY.

vector.description: Required VECTOR algorithm, type, dimension, metric, and tuning options.

algorithm.description: Vector index algorithm: FLAT for exact search or HNSW for approximate search.

data_type.description: Element representation used in Redis: FLOAT32 or FLOAT64.

dimensions.description: Number of elements in each vector.

distance_metric.description: Distance metric: L2, IP, or COSINE.

ef_runtime.description: Optional default HNSW runtime candidate count.

epsilon.description: Optional HNSW range-query relative distance factor.

m.description: Optional HNSW maximum outgoing edges per node.

protocol.description: Run bounded KNN search combined with typed, escaped text, tag, numeric, and geo filters.

oneOf.description: Match one escaped literal text value.
Match any one of the escaped literal tag values.
Match a numeric range. Omitted endpoints mean negative or positive infinity.
Match a point within a radius of a geographic coordinate.

batch_size.description: Optional batch size, valid only with hybrid_policy=batches.

data_type.description: Element representation expected by the index.

filters.description: Typed text, tag, numeric, and geo clauses combined with AND.

hybrid_policy.description: Optional Query Engine hybrid execution policy.

limit_num.description: Maximum results returned by this page, bounded to 100.

limit_offset.description: Offset within the top-k neighbors. Follow page.continuation.offset.

return_fields.description: Additional fields to return with each document.

score_alias.description: Alias used for the computed distance field.

shard_k_ratio.description: Cluster shard over-fetch ratio between 0.1 and 1.0, with at most two decimals.

top_k.description: Number of nearest neighbors considered, bounded to 100.

vector.description: Numeric query vector. Its length must equal the index dimension.

vector_field.description: Query-facing alias of the indexed VECTOR field.

max_returned_bytes.description: Maximum aggregate bytes of popped elements to include. Larger results are reported as omitted so the mutation remains observable.

max_len.description: Maximum number of list elements to scan. Zero or omission means no scan limit.

rank.description: Match rank. Positive ranks search from the head and negative ranks from the tail; zero is invalid.
